ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Accuracy Shipping Limited has secured a Letter of Intent for its subsidiary to establish a Container Freight Station (CFS) at Kandla, Gujarat, marking a strategic expansion of its logistics and cargo handling capabilities. This project, with an estimated capital expenditure of ₹25 crore, is projected to generate ₹175-200 crore in annual revenue at full utilization and achieve double-digit EBITDA margins within one year. Investors should note these financial projections are forward-looking and contingent on successful project execution and market demand, as highlighted by the customary disclaimers.
